known_failures.note: Bugs seen while reading the test documents in the previous pass. Each was found after that test run and left unfixed there. This pass fixed the causes on the development split only, and re-scored the untouched test split once afterwards.
rule_decisions: Only top-level breakdown items count as grading gold. The four sub-weights on PHYS S102E ('written test' 15, 'oral test' 5, 'online section discussion' 10, 'participation' 10) are printed inside a parent category, so the rule scores them as misses when emitted. The extractor no longer emits them: a nested breakdown of a category it already returned is kept out of the top-level list, which is why this pass has 33 grading values rather than 36.

failures.dev_check: A body that opens another labelled field ('Class:', 'Course Dates:', 'Lecture Times:') is rejected, and a flattened line is cut at that label. On dev, two office-hours sections whose body ran into the next field are now cut at that field (one returns 'Noon-1pm or by appointment' instead of the following 'Course Dates'/'Lecture Times' block), one 'TBA' body is rejected, and no emitted office-hours value contains another field's label; 14/14 judged office-hours values are correct.
failures.note: The extracted office-hours value is the *next* section's body ('Class: Thursday E1-E3 ... Screening: Wednesday ...'), not the section the evidence span points at ('Office Hours: Wednesday periods 9-11').

failures.dev_check: Still open. The heading is right and the prose that follows is about the course, not about office hours; rejecting it needs a judgement about the body's topic that the current cues cannot make without also dropping real narrative office hours (dev 1c22a5fd is the same shape and is correct).
failures.note: Office-hours body is the course overview text that follows the heading, so 'By appointment' never appears in the value. Emitted at confidence 1.000.

failures.dev_check: Same shape as 8c7d8e3a and still open: the following block mentions contact details, which is a legitimate office-hours cue, so the value is not rejected.
failures.note: Office-hours body is the instructor/email block that follows, not 'Schedule via email'. Emitted at confidence 1.000.

failures.dev_check: A placeholder body ('TBD', 'TBA', 'None.') is rejected before any cue check, and the glued bullet is cut off the value. On dev, a 'TBA' office-hours body (5ec8c4a7) is rejected; the same rule is covered by a unit test.
failures.note: The document states only 'Office Hours: TBD', which is not an office hour; the body is emitted anyway (with the next bullet glued on), at confidence 1.000.

failures.dev_check: Same placeholder gate as 774089f9, plus the cut that drops the glued email line.
failures.note: Same shape: 'Office Hours of Professor: TBD' is emitted as a value, glued to the email line.

failures.dev_check: A code preceded by 'Office:', 'Room:', 'Hall' or 'in' is rejected, and an explicitly labelled 'Course Code:' line is preferred. On dev, documents with 'Office: PAR 404' and 'Office: WEL 5.239' now return RHE 306 and CH301.
failures.note: The instructor's office number 'MAT 328' is emitted as the course code, at confidence 0.991; the document's actual code is printed on an adjacent line as 'Course Code: ECO 3704'.

failures.dev_check: Rooms are rejected by the preceding-location cue, the dotted room form ('WEL 5.132') and schedule lines ('MWF 1351'). On dev, 'Office/hours: WEH 6213/TBA' no longer wins the field.
failures.note: The meeting room 'CRR 0521' is emitted as a course code, at confidence 0.982.

failures.dev_check: Same location rules as 63260c26. A code without a catalogue label now carries confidence 0.5 rather than the section softmax, so it no longer looks certain.
failures.note: The room 'FLO 100' is emitted as a course code; here the confidence (0.002) at least admits it is a guess.

failures.dev_check: A parenthetical that carries two weights is read as a breakdown, not as categories; a weight inside parentheses is a component when the line already stated a top-level one; and either end of an 'X-Y%' range is skipped. On dev, 51e338bc ('WebAssign 15% (Lecture-quizzes 5% + Homework 10%)') now returns WebAssign 15 only, total 100, and 639f5558's 90-100% scale rows are gone.
failures.note: The parenthetical '(25% lowest, 35% best)' is split into category fragments 'lowest' and 'best)' at confidence 0.996, and 'Extra Credit 0-1%' becomes the category 'Extra Credit 0'.

failures.dev_check: The nested categories are recorded as components of the parent weight and suppressed, including when the document repeats them on their own lines later. On dev, 51e338bc's repeated 'Lecture-quizzes 5' and 'Homework 10' lines no longer inflate the breakdown.
failures.note: Nested sub-weights are flattened into top-level categories: 'written test' 15%, 'oral test' 5%, 'online section discussion' 10%, 'participation' 10%. The values are printed in the document, but a reader summing the categories now gets more than 100%.

failures.dev_check: Section headings are not titles: generic headings ('General Information', 'Summary Assignment and Grading', 'Teaching Assistants', 'Supplementary Materials'), place names, clock times, contact lines and code-only or session lines are rejected before ranking. On dev, 3/3 judged titles are correct and no chosen title is one of the rejected heading forms.
failures.note: 'General Information' — a section heading that occurs verbatim in the document — is returned as the title at confidence 0.995.
The session code 'SA25' in the title line is emitted as a course code.

failures.dev_check: Not attempted: found after the test split had been scored, so fixing it would need a second look at the test set.
